info.title: Voice Support Platform gateway
info.description: Generated from the gateway route definitions (platform/src/gateway/openapi.ts). Every authenticated route requires an integration access token for its own channel (mcp_tools, telephony_control, portal); the caller session is carried only in the trusted X-VSP-Session-Ref header, never in a URL, body or tool argument. Errors use a generic body with a reason code and an opaque request id. The webhook route accepts only the LOCAL FIXTURE HMAC in local/ci and answers WEBHOOK_AUTH_UNVERIFIED elsewhere (the vendor signature scheme is not yet confirmed).
